pages.title: Work queue
pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, high fidelity desktop web application mockup for "Autonomous Finance", an evidence-backed accounts payable workspace. One full page, flat front view, edge-to-edge screen, landscape 16:10, 1600x1000 or higher. Not a collage, no device frame, no browser controls. Legible carefully typeset text. Think thoughtful enterprise product design, compact tables, generous alignment, quiet borders, no decorative charts, no gradients or marketing.
Use the project's locked design system: warm off-white #f6f5f1, sidebar #efeee8, white work area, dark forest ink #1d2320, secondary text #58635b, fine borders #d7dbd3, dark green primary action #1f6f4a, pale green selected surface #e3ece1, muted amber for waiting. System sans resembling Avenir/Inter, tabular numbers, sentence case. Rounded corners 6px, almost no shadow.
Layout invariant across this series: 216px full-height warm sidebar with small understated wordmark "Autonomous Finance" on two lines at top; a workspace selector "AP workspace". Sidebar links in order: "Work queue", "Documents", "Approvals", "Payments", "Reconciliation", "Suppliers", "History & policies", "Integrations". Small monochrome outline icons, selected link pale green. Bottom sidebar label "Golden State case" and "Synthetic example".
Main area top white strip: breadcrumb at left, search at right, role chip "AP reviewer". Small persistent top-right badge "Design concept". Bottom left in main area small caption "Proposed UI / illustrative states". This is visibly a proposed future product, NOT a screenshot proving live implementation.
Use only the established illustrative case from issue #97: supplier Golden State Produce, invoice INV-1001, USD 662.90. It is a synthetic document; amounts/roles/states are illustrative. No other invented financial totals, customer counts, uptime, accuracy or performance metrics. Do not use speculative percentages. No real secrets, bank account numbers or invented personal names.
Copy should be concise and human-oriented; technical IDs, hashes and raw diagnostics hidden under details. No vague all-purpose green Complete badge.
Selected sidebar: Work queue. Page title "Your AP work". Subtitle "Move each obligation forward with the right evidence." Primary action "Upload documents" top right.
Below, a restrained horizontally divided status strip with four text states, no numeric counters: "Needs evidence", "Ready for review", "Awaiting authorization", "Recovering". First selected with amber underline.
Main large table takes two thirds width: heading "Needs your attention", filter "All owners", search. Columns "Case", "Amount", "Stage", "Owner", "Next action". Show one detailed selected record: Golden State Produce / INV-1001, $662.90, amber "Missing receipt", owner "Receiving team", text action "Open case". Under row concise line "Invoice received. Delivery evidence is still needed." Below it a slim informational row "Renamed upload detected" / "Linked to the existing case".
Right contextual panel heading "What happens next". Amber summary "Waiting for receipt". Rows "Owner / Receiving team", "Required evidence / Delivery receipt", "Payment / Not authorized". One green button "Request evidence". Below a chronological mini-list "Invoice received", "Fields extracted", "Receipt requested", with "Message status: Draft" clearly visible; do not imply sent.
Bottom wide section "One case, connected records" with six small connected text tabs "Source", "Bill", "Review", "Payment", "Bank", "Journal". Current Source and Review outlined; later stages gray. Compact note "Open any record without losing the case."
Strong composition: useful information density but ample white space, 28px title, 14–16px content. No dashboard KPI tiles.
